app.name: SteadyHum
app.tagline: Your appliances have a normal. SteadyHum learns it and tells you when it changes.

applianceType.heat-pump: Heat pump or AC outdoor unit

empty.title: Nothing to listen to yet
empty.body: Add an appliance and teach SteadyHum what it sounds like when it is fine.

addAppliance.title: Add appliance
addAppliance.placementPlaceholder: On the shelf to the left, at chest height
addAppliance.placementHelp: The closer the position is to last time, the more reliable the checks.
addAppliance.nameRequired: Give it a name so you can tell it apart.

appliance.deleteConfirm: Delete {name} and all its history? This cannot be undone.

enroll.title: Learn its normal
enroll.intro: Record the machine three times while it is working well, ideally at different moments of its cycle. Hold the phone in the same spot each time.
enroll.notLearned: A few more sessions are needed for a reliable normal.
enroll.statesFound: I found {count} distinct sound states in this recording.
enroll.statesFound_one: I found 1 sound state in this recording.
enroll.noiseHint: I hear a voice, wait a moment.
enroll.musicHint: I hear music or a TV, wait a moment.
enroll.tooQuiet: I can barely hear anything. Move the phone closer to the machine.
enroll.addMore: You can add more sessions any time: the more there are, the tighter the warning.

check.title: Listen now
check.hold: Hold the phone where you always do.
check.needsProfile: First teach SteadyHum what it sounds like when it is fine.

verdict.normal: It sounds like it always does.
verdict.unusableBody: There was too much background noise in more than 40% of the recording. Try again somewhere quieter.
verdict.matchedState: This matches state {state} of the ones I learned.
verdict.unmatchedState: This may be a phase I never heard during learning. If the machine was doing something new, add a session.
verdict.levelGuard: The phone seems closer or farther than during learning.
verdict.askTechnician: If in doubt, ask a technician.
verdict.feedbackThanks: Thanks. I will take that into account next time.
verdict.keepClip: Keep the audio clip on this phone
verdict.comparedWith: Compared with the normal learned on {date}

band-energy.new: New energy has appeared between {lowHz} and {highHz} Hz.
band-energy.gone: The energy between {lowHz} and {highHz} Hz is gone.

tonal-peak.new: A new steady tone near {frequencyHz} Hz (a whine).
tonal-peak.gone: The tone near {frequencyHz} Hz is gone.
tonal-peak.more: The tone near {frequencyHz} Hz is louder.
tonal-peak.less: The tone near {frequencyHz} Hz is quieter.

onset-periodicity.new: Regular knocks about {rateHz} times per second (rattle or imbalance).
onset-periodicity.more: The knocks are more frequent than before.
onset-periodicity.less: The knocks are less frequent than before.

spectral-flatness.more: The sound is rougher or noisier than before.
spectral-flatness.less: The sound is cleaner than before.
spectral-flatness.gone: The machine's background noise is gone.

spectral-centroid.more: The sound is higher pitched than before.
spectral-centroid.less: The sound is deeper than before.

amplitude-modulation.new: The hum pulses about {rateHz} times per second.
amplitude-modulation.more: The hum pulses faster than before.
amplitude-modulation.less: The hum pulses slower than before.

engine.title: The audio engine is not available yet
engine.notInstalled: SteadyHum listens through earshot, the shared audio engine. No release is published yet, so recording and scoring are turned off. Everything else works.
engine.microphoneDenied: I need permission to use the microphone. Turn it on in the browser settings and try again.
engine.unsupportedBrowser: This browser does not have what I need to analyse sound. Try Chrome on Android or Safari on iOS 17 or newer.
engine.modelLoadFailed: I could not load the models. Check your connection the first time you open the app.
engine.processingFlags: This browser did not turn off its own audio processing. Results may be less reliable.
engine.unknown: Something went wrong while preparing the microphone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.deeperAnalysisHelp: Downloads an extra model to describe changes better. It takes more space.
settings.keepClipsHelp: Only on this phone, and only around the moments that sound different.
settings.importError: I could not read that file: {reason}.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.headline: Audio never leaves this phone.
privacy.body: SteadyHum analyses sound inside the browser. There are no accounts, no server and nothing is uploaded. The only downloads are the app itself and the models.
privacy.storedTitle: What is stored on this phone
privacy.storedAudio: Audio clips: only if you turn them on, and you can delete them any time.
privacy.storedProfiles: The learned normal of each machine: numbers, not sound.
privacy.storedHistory: The history of checks and your answers.
privacy.disclaimer: SteadyHum is consumer information, not professional advice. It does not diagnose faults. Gas appliances must always be checked by a certified technician. It is not a medical or safety device.
